class.name: FoxHitShapeCast3D
class.brief_description: Delivers a [Variant] payload to all [FoxHurtArea3D] nodes it strikes.
class.description: Acts as a "thick raycast" or swept-shape trigger. Perfect for thick lasers or high-speed melee sweeps that might tunnel through standard areas.

method.name: fire
method.description: Forces the shapecast to update immediately and attempts to deliver the [member payload].

members.member: The arbitrary data this shapecast will deliver upon intersection.

signal.name: hit_delivered
signal.description: Emitted when this shapecast successfully delivers its [param payload] to a [param target].
